fusions.name: Startling Pop
fusions.desc: Fires a loud shot that deals 12 damage to the first enemy in its path and stuns it for 1.2 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Buckshot Feed
fusions.desc: Looses 3 pellets at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage. Your movement speed rises by 15% for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Sighting Perch
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 13 seconds. A chick fights beside you for 10 seconds, pecking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Echoing Report
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a second bolt hits the next nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
